Key features you explored:  
💡 EV Mode: Smooth, eco-friendly driving for effortless city commutes.  
💡 Head Up Display: Stay focused on the road with essential information displayed right in your line of sight.  
💡 Wireless Charging: Convenience at its best — no more tangled cables!  
🛡️ 6 Airbags as Standard: Safety for every passenger, ensuring peace of mind.  
🛡️ Hill-descent Control: Confident drives even on steep terrains.  

Best in segment features because…  
✅ Exceptional fuel efficiency at 21.11 kmpl — great for savings and sustainability.  
✅ Advanced safety technologies like TPMS, ESP, and Hill Hold Assist for unmatched protection.  
✅ SmartPlay Pro touchscreen infotainment system for seamless connectivity and entertainment.  

Your positive engagement and curiosity about the Grand Vitara tell us you’re looking for a refined, future-ready SUV that delivers on performance and advanced technology. We’re thrilled that you’ve booked a test drive! 🥳 Imagine the thrill of experiencing its hybrid powertrain and cutting-edge features firsthand.  

Our team is ready to assist with next steps, whether it’s locating a dealer or answering any questions. We can’t wait to see you behind the wheel! 🚘✨

    "subject": "Your Test Drive Booking for the Grand Vitara in Arctic White",
    "message": "Dear G. Ananth,

Dave and the Team"
